column3: NKJV has “I had baptized,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “you were baptized.”
NKJV includes “of this world,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
NKJV has “a sign,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “signs.”
NKJV has “to the Greeks,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “to the Gentiles.”
NKJV has “in His presence,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “before God.”
